name: AI Usage
description: Shows how much of an AI coding plan you've used (Claude, Codex, Cursor…) and when it resets, refreshed every 30 seconds: session use and a countdown, with a chart of session (green) and weekly (red) use. Reads the OpenUsage app's local API on this Mac only. Pressing the button opens OpenUsage.
label: AI
note: Needs OpenUsage (github.com/robinebers/openusage) running: brew install --cask openusage.
